# AI Study Method

> Free interactive mini-lessons, quizzes, revision guides and games for GCSE, A-Level, IB Diploma, AP (Advanced Placement) and KS3, organized by exam board and course, and built around the Velvet Method, a six-step study system. No login. Lesson content is checked by at least two frontier AI models and read through by subject-specialist teachers.

Each mini-lesson takes about 20 minutes. It opens with a short video question, then works through the topic in missions with worked examples and multiple-choice checks. AP courses follow the College Board course frameworks and use US English; UK courses follow each exam board's specification.

## Start here

- [All mini-lessons by course](https://aistudymethod.com/lessons.html): every course and exam board, with a lesson finder
- [Velvet Revision](https://aistudymethod.com/subjects.html): pick a course and exam board, then take any topic through six stages (View, Evaluate, Learn, Verify, Explore, Transform)
- [Revision guides](https://aistudymethod.com/revise/): topic-by-topic guides with key concepts and common mistakes
- [For teachers](https://aistudymethod.com/teachers.html): free lessons to assign as class work or homework, by course
- [The Velvet Method](https://aistudymethod.com/velvet-method.html): the six-step study method and a free AI prompt library

## AP Physics

- [AP Physics review (all four courses)](https://aistudymethod.com/revise/ap-physics.html)
- [AP Physics 1 review guide](https://aistudymethod.com/revise/ap-physics-1.html) and [AP Physics 1 lessons](https://aistudymethod.com/lessons/physics-ap-physics-1.html): Units 1–8, algebra-based mechanics
- [AP Physics 2 review guide](https://aistudymethod.com/revise/ap-physics-2.html) and [AP Physics 2 lessons](https://aistudymethod.com/lessons/physics-ap-physics-2.html): Units 9–15, thermodynamics, electricity and magnetism, optics, waves and modern physics
- [AP Physics C: Mechanics review guide](https://aistudymethod.com/revise/ap-physics-c-mechanics.html) and [lessons](https://aistudymethod.com/lessons/physics-ap-physics-c-mechanics.html): Units 1–7, calculus-based mechanics
- [AP Physics C: Electricity and Magnetism review guide](https://aistudymethod.com/revise/ap-physics-c-em.html) and [lessons](https://aistudymethod.com/lessons/physics-ap-physics-c-em.html): Units 8–13, calculus-based electricity and magnetism

## AP Chemistry

- [AP Chemistry review guide](https://aistudymethod.com/revise/ap-chemistry.html): Units 1–9, key concepts, common mistakes and practice questions by unit
- [AP Chemistry lessons](https://aistudymethod.com/lessons/chemistry-ap-collegeboard.html): 16 interactive lessons in College Board unit order
